description: Place an order. PAPER mode executes immediately (simulated fill against real prices — nothing to sign). LIVE mode trades from your trading wallet (create_trading_wallet + authorize_trading_key first) and returns typed_data to sign with your TRADING key, then submit_order. Fees: 0.25% per perps trade, the same everyone pays, settled automatically. Brackets: pass tp/sl. Sizing: explicit size, or risk-first via risk_usd+stop_price (size = risk / |entry−stop|). Min notional $10.

limit_price.description: Limit price in USD; required when type is limit

reduce_only.description: true = this order can only reduce an existing position, never open or flip one

risk_usd.description: Risk-first sizing: dollars at risk to the stop

side.description: buy = go long (or reduce a short); sell = go short (or reduce a long)

size.description: Size in coins, e.g. 0.01 for BTC. Omit it to size by risk_usd + stop_price instead

sl.description: Stop-loss trigger price in USD (optional reduce-only bracket)

stop_price.description: Required with risk_usd; also becomes the SL

tp.description: Take-profit trigger price in USD (optional reduce-only bracket)

type.description: market = fills now at a protected price; limit = rests at limit_price

name: place_order
